body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy misses an Action while Exposed, or ends an Action without detecting you despite your nearby concealment. Response: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage.

surges.html: After a hit, move 1 unit around it.
On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
